title: Deductible Rate in Site-Change Estimates: Coverage Verification Age on the Study Date
content:
The deductible rate in the site-change estimate for an Advanced Imaging Prior Authorization or an Outpatient Procedure Prior Authorization moved to another site (Referrals & Prior Authorizations) follows the patient's Patient Financial Account:

- where the financial class collects a deductible share at the time of service and the last coverage verification will be older than that class's re-verification period on the study date, the rate is 100 percent;
- where the class collects a deductible share and the last coverage verification will still be within that period on the study date, the rate is the class's deductible collection percentage;
- otherwise the rate is zero.

## Terms

- **Collects a deductible share at the time of service**: the financial class's deductible collection percentage is above zero.
- **Age of the last coverage verification on the study date**: the number of calendar days from the coverage verification date recorded on the Patient Financial Account to the scheduled date of the study booked against the authorization.
- **Older than the period**: that age is greater than the class's re-verification period in days. **Within the period**: the age is equal to or less than it.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical class with a re-verification period of 90 days and a collection percentage of 20)

| Last coverage verification | Study date | Age on the study date | Rate |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-01-01 | 2026-04-01 | 90 days — within the period | 20 percent |
| 2026-01-01 | 2026-04-02 | 91 days — older than the period | 100 percent |

For a class whose deductible collection percentage is zero, the rate is zero whatever the age of the verification.
